notes: Concept/proposal paper for a table-top electrostatic storage ring for polarized ions. Presents projected sensitivities (not measured limits) for axion-electron coupling (demonstrator, Fig. 4 left) and axion-nucleon coupling (final stage with polarized Xe sample, Fig. 4 right), spanning masses ~1e-19 to 1e-10 eV. Also mentions sensitivity to dark photon DM and EDMs, so multiple coupling types are discussed. No numerical sensitivity values are given in text or tables — projections appear only in a figure whose curves cannot be read from the provided content, hence data_points is empty and extraction confidence is low.
